    7. Non-standard subsystems: Van der Pol meets Bouc-Wen¶

    Nothing in the framework assumes masses and springs. 07_vanderpol_boucwen.yaml couples a Van der Pol oscillator with an unknown nonlinearity mu (UKF, RK4) to a Bouc-Wen hysteretic element with unknown beta and gamma (CKF) through a spring-damper interface, with Gauss-Seidel messages. Both subsystems are written as equation strings (model: custom, needs sympy); the ground truth is the same coupled model simulated with the true parameters.

    In [1]:
    Copied! 
    import pci

print(open("07_vanderpol_boucwen.yaml").read())
    import pci print(open("07_vanderpol_boucwen.yaml").read())
    # Two non-standard subsystems written as equation strings (model: custom): a Van der Pol oscillator with
# unknown mu (UKF, RK4) coupled by a spring-damper to a Bouc-Wen hysteretic element with unknown beta, gamma (CKF).
# Solve with:  pci.solve("07_vanderpol_boucwen.yaml")
model: custom
subsystems:
  VdP:
    states: [q, v]
    inputs: [f]
    parameters: {m: 1.0, w: 2.0}
    unknowns: {mu: {initial: 0.4, std: 0.5}}
    equations: {q: v, v: (f + mu*(1 - q**2)*v - w**2*q) / m}
    measurements: {a_vdp: (f + mu*(1 - q**2)*v - w**2*q) / m}
    noise_std: {a_vdp: 1.0e-2}
    filter: ukf
    integrator: rk4
    x0: {q: 0.5}
  BW:
    states: [q, v, z]
    inputs: [f]
    parameters: {m: 1.0, c: 0.1, alpha: 0.5, k: 100.0, A: 1.0, n: 1.0}
    unknowns: {beta: {initial: 0.2, std: 0.3}, gamma: {initial: 0.2, std: 0.3}}
    equations:
      q: v
      v: (f - c*v - alpha*k*q - (1 - alpha)*k*z) / m
      z: A*v - beta*Abs(v)*Abs(z)**(n - 1)*z - gamma*v*Abs(z)**n
    measurements: {q_bw: q, a_bw: (f - c*v - alpha*k*q - (1 - alpha)*k*z) / m}
    noise_std: {q_bw: 1.0e-4, a_bw: 1.0e-2}
    filter: ckf
interfaces:
  - {type: spring_damper, a: VdP, a_vars: [q, v], a_port: f, b: BW, b_vars: [q, v], b_port: f, k: 20.0, c: 0.5, name: F_link}
schedule: gauss_seidel
loads: {VdP.f: {type: harmonic, amplitude: 3.0, frequency: 0.3}, BW.f: {type: random, std: 20.0, seed: 4}}
time: {dt: 1.0e-3, T: 30.0}
truth: {parameters: {VdP.mu: 1.0, BW.beta: 0.5, BW.gamma: 0.5}, x0: {VdP.q: 0.5}, schedule: ab2, seed: 0}
prior: {r_inflation: 1}

print(results.summary(start=15.0))

    The hysteretic variable z of the Bouc-Wen element is not measured; it is reconstructed from the displacement and acceleration sensors together with the parameters. Abs in the equations is the sympy absolute value, so the CKF sigma points pass through the non-smooth term without a Jacobian.
